shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node --version; npm --version

BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3999 node server.js & sleep 1
loc=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=The Hobbit&author=J.R.R. Tolkien&notes=Second read' http://127.0.0.1:3999/books); echo "redirect: $loc"
curl -s "$loc" | sed -n '/<body>/,$p'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'finish: %{http_code}\n' -d 'from=home' "$loc/finish"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3999/ | grep -A3 '<h2>Finished'
cat /tmp/smoke/books.json; kill %1; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
